item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q009_heme_bundle_fold_not_homology","answer":"No. In SCOPe these proteins belong in the membrane-protein class and share the same heme-binding four-helix-bundle fold, but they are split below that level rather than united in a single homologous superfamily. Transfers that require homology, such as assigning the fumarate-reductase membrane-subunit role or the nitrate-reductase gamma-chain role across the whole fold, are unsafe; at most the fold supports the broad structural observation that these are membrane four-helix bundles binding b-type heme cofactors.
